title: Parsnip and apple slaw on toast

grandparents_cupboard.reason: Every ingredient is a plain whole food or a basic cupboard staple, and tahini is on the store cupboard list.

supermarket.reason: Parsnips, carrots, apple, tahini, sunflower seeds and wholemeal bread are all everyday Tesco items at normal prices.

basic_kitchen.reason: It needs only a grater, a bowl, a small pan and a toaster or grill, and nothing beyond grating and whisking.

works.reason: Two parsnips, two carrots and an apple make enough slaw for four slices of toast as a snack, and the salt-and-vinegar soak softens the raw parsnip while the tahini dressing is well balanced.

honest_times.reason: Fifteen minutes is fair for peeling and grating the roots, whisking the dressing and toasting, and the 15 cook minutes match the unattended soak.

honest_ingredients.reason: Every listed ingredient and seasoning, including the lemon and pepper, appears in the steps, and the names match their ids.

seasonal_feel.reason: Parsnip is the bulk of the slaw, and a winter root and apple slaw on hot toast suits late January.

plain_voice.reason: The steps are short, clear, plain British English with no fuss or preaching.

hearty_healthy.reason: Raw vegetables, tahini, seeds and wholemeal toast make a filling, wholesome snack with only a teaspoon of sugar.
